name: .277 Cal-139gr Absolute Hammer™
note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "I know… Our 1st .277 Cal Absolute Hammer™ is for a custom twist. But we just built two 270 Sherman Short Mags and they need a bullet for the hunting season coming up fast. The 140gr 9″ twist Absolute Hammer™ should run about 3200 to 3300 in the Sherman Short mag. Load for the Absolute Hammer™s with extreme caution as they do not line up with conventional data and they should be used by experienced re-loaders only." The product name says 139 gr; the specification says 140 gr.
